tips.text: Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, not after. The cast time is much safer to spend before the fight starts.
Stay on your target with basic attacks. They build Quaking, and a full stack deals extra damage based on the enemy's max Health.
Steer Ixtal's Impact so the enemy you grab hits a wall. That stuns them and deals damage.
Skarner can't be slowed during Ixtal's Impact, so use it to chase or to cross terrain. A stun or knock-up on him will end it, so watch for those.
Use Impale to pull an enemy into your team, where your allies can hit them. It can hit up to three champions.
Cast Impale while Shattered Earth is active to throw the boulder at once with no cast time. It's a good way to finish a fleeing enemy.
Use Seismic Bastion when you step into a fight. The shield and the slow help you stick to your target.
Capture Crystal Spires before you contest objectives or fight near them. Skarner is much stronger in those fights.

combos.name: Pre-cast Q before engage
combos.when: Before charging into an enemy or a gank from fog or safety.
combos.text: Cast Shattered Earth first so its short cast time is already done. Then charge in and hit with the empowered attacks right away.

tips.text: Charge with Ixtal's Impact at Aatrox when a wall is behind him; hitting it stuns him and deals damage.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, so you aren't waiting out its cast time in the fight.
Hold Impale until Aatrox uses Umbral Dash, then pin him so he can't escape and your team can hit him.
Stay on Aatrox with attacks to keep Quaking stacked. The damage over time adds up in a long fight.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, not after; the cast time in the middle of a fight leaves you open.
Aim Ixtal's Impact so Ambessa ends up against a wall; she is stunned and takes damage, and you get the cooldown back faster.
Stay on Ambessa with attacks so Quaking stacks up; her dashes make her slippery, so use Seismic Bastion to slow her and keep close.
Use Impale on Ambessa when she commits to a dash, then drag her toward your team.
Stay out of a straight line with Amumu and keep minions between you, because Bandage Toss stops at the first unit it hits.
Don't stand next to your allies when Amumu has Curse of the Sad Mummy ready.
Use Shattered Earth before you commit to a fight; its attacks and Upheaval slow Amumu and stack Quaking.
Impale pulls in several enemies, so use it to separate Amumu from his team.
Catch Bel'Veth with Ixtal's Impact and run her into a wall; she is stunned and takes damage, and she cannot attack or cast while you drag her.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, so your empowered attacks and slow are ready the moment you reach her.
Save Impale for when Bel'Veth commits to a fight; she cannot dash away while suppressed, and your allies can then hit her freely.
Keep hitting her to build Quaking; her attack speed makes short trades risky, so stay on her and finish with the full stack.
Use Seismic Bastion when she dives on you; the shield and slow soften her attack-speed burst.
Close the gap with Shattered Earth ready, and stay on Brand so his poke can't keep you away.
Dodge Brand's Sear. Without a first hit, he can't set up his stun.
Use Ixtal's Impact to grab Brand and carry him into a wall. He has no escape from the stun.
Keep Seismic Bastion for when Brand's Pillar of Flame lands. The shield softens his burst.
Stay away from your allies when Brand casts Pyroclasm. It bounces between enemies and starts slowly, so you have time to move.
Use Ixtal's Impact to catch Briar and drag her into a wall. She gets stunned and takes heavy damage, and it also stops her from killing you.
Save Impale for when Briar jumps in. Suppressing her cuts short her Blood Frenzy attacks and lets your team hit her.
Cast Shattered Earth before you fight her. Your attacks then hit harder and slow her, so she has a hard time running or chasing.
Hit Briar with Seismic Bastion when she jumps on you. The shield absorbs some of her burst and the slow makes it harder for her to stay on you.
Aim Ixtal's Impact so Darius gets carried into a wall; the crash stuns him and deals damage.
Cast Shattered Earth before you charge in, so your boosted attacks are ready when you arrive.
Throw the boulder with Upheaval when Darius runs away; it slows him so you can catch him.
Use Impale to pull Darius away from your allies or hold him still for your team.
Keep hitting Darius to stack Quaking; a long fight lets it deal heavy damage.
Hold Ixtal's Impact for when Diana jumps in. Steer her into a wall to stun her and punish her for diving.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage Diana. Her short, bursty fights punish you for waiting on its cast time mid-fight.
Use Impale to pin Diana when she dives in. She cannot act while Skarner drags her, so your allies can kill her.
Skarner is sturdy, so stay on Diana with attacks and let Threads of Vibration build up. Her burst has to fight through that.
Diana's shield from Pale Cascade soaks your damage. Wait for the orbs to fade before you commit to a trade.
Charge with Ixtal's Impact into a wall to stun Mundo. His passive can resist the first stun-style effect, so expect it to be absorbed.
Stay on Mundo with attacks to build Quaking; its health-based damage works well against his large health pool.
Step out of his Infected Bonesaw line; it is a thin shot that stops at the first enemy it hits.
Burst Mundo right after he uses Maximum Dosage, or he will heal through your damage.
Use Seismic Bastion to slow Mundo while shielding yourself when he runs in with Heart Zapper.
Start Ixtal's Impact when Ekko is near a wall; if you drag him into it, he is stunned and takes damage.
Hold Impale until Ekko uses Phase Dive or Chronobreak. Then he can't easily escape the suppression.
Cast Shattered Earth before you dive on Ekko, so you don't wait out its cast time in the fight.
Stay on Ekko with attacks to build Quaking. His Timewinder slow doesn't stop Ixtal's Impact, because you are immune to slows during it.
Don't charge into Parallel Convergence when you see it placed. If Ekko enters it, you get stunned.
Use Impale on Evelynn the moment she shows herself; suppressing her ends her ambush before it starts.
When an arrow shows Allure is on you and it has matured, stay near allies and walk away from Evelynn; being charmed is how she kills you.
Evelynn is fragile, so stick to her with Shattered Earth attacks. Her Allure slow does not last long, so keep closing in.
Seismic Bastion gives you a shield and slows nearby enemies. Cast it when Evelynn jumps in on you.
Do not chase Evelynn after Last Caress; she blinks backward and becomes untargetable first. Wait for her to come back.
Do not walk into brush where Fiddlesticks may be hiding or posing as a scarecrow; a surprise fear leaves you open to his full combo.
Look for the moment Fiddlesticks uses Reap or Terrify, then charge in with Ixtal's Impact before his cooldowns return.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage so your hits are empowered and you can stick to Fiddlesticks.
Get out of Crowstorm's area early. Hitting Fiddlesticks with Impale during the channel drags him away from his target.
Use Ixtal's Impact to grab Graves and run him into a wall; it stuns him and deals damage.
Hold Impale until Graves has used Quickdraw, then lash out at him so he cannot escape and your team can hit him.
Stay on Graves with attacks so Threads of Vibration reaches full stacks. He has little health to spare in a long fight.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, so you are not waiting on its cast time while Graves shoots you.
Ixtal's Impact makes you immune to slows, so charge through Smoke Screen without worry.
Hold Ixtal's Impact until Gwen steps out of her Hallowed Mist; she cannot be targeted while she stays inside it.
Charge Gwen toward a wall with Ixtal's Impact; hitting it with her in tow stuns her and deals damage.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, so you are not waiting on its cast time in the middle of the fight.
Throw Upheaval at Gwen when she tries to run; the boulder slows her.
Stay on Gwen with attacks; Quaking stacks and hurts her over time.
Hit Hecarim with Ixtal's Impact when he charges at you or your allies; it grabs him and stuns him if you run him into a wall.
Dodge Onslaught of Shadows by moving out of the line of riders. The fear at the end only reaches enemies near where he stops.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, so the slow from its last hit lands while you chase him.
Skarner holds up in a fight. Stay on Hecarim with attacks to keep Quaking stacked, since he lacks durability.
Use Impale on Hecarim once he commits with Devastating Charge, so he is held and your team can hit him.
Catch Ivern with Ixtal's Impact and drag him into a wall; the wall hit stuns him and deals big damage.
Cast Shattered Earth before you charge in, so you are not waiting on its cast time while fighting.
Ixtal's Impact is stopped by a root, so Ivern's Rootcaller can end your charge. Wait for it to be used first.
Impale Ivern when he is away from Daisy and his team. He has little escape once suppressed.
Check Ivern's brush before you walk in; ambushes there are common.
Keep Ixtal's Impact ready to drag Jarvan into a wall. It stuns him and deals damage.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard, or you get knocked up by Dragon Strike.
Cast Shattered Earth before you start a fight with Jarvan. His Cataclysm walls trap you inside, so stick to him and keep hitting.
Dodge Dragon Strike by moving sideways. Skarner's Seismic Bastion shield helps when you do get caught.
Wait out Counter Strike before you hit Jax; his dodge ends in a stun, so do not attack into it.
Use Impale from range to pull Jax away from his team; it can be dodged, so cast it when he has no easy escape.
Do not ignore Jax's leap to wards; chasing him is hard, so save Ixtal's Impact to catch him and drag him into a wall.
Use Seismic Bastion when Jax jumps in; the shield helps you, and the slow makes his chase worse.
Charge with Ixtal's Impact and run Jayce into a wall; he is stunned and takes damage. Jayce is a fragile target who cannot easily break out of it.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage so the empowered attacks are ready the moment you reach Jayce.
Stay on Jayce with attacks to build Quaking; it deals extra damage to him over time if he cannot get away.
Use Impale to pull Jayce away from his allies and hold him in place. He can't swap stances or cast while suppressed.
Charge with Ixtal's Impact at Karthus and drag him into a wall for a stun; he has little to escape with once caught.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage Karthus, so your first hits land fast and you can use Impale at once.
Step away from Karthus's corpse after you kill him; he can still cast Lay Waste and Defile for a short time.
Stay healthy enough to survive Requiem; Karthus's ultimate reaches you anywhere, and you cannot dodge it.
Seismic Bastion's shield helps you survive Lay Waste poke when you must walk up to Karthus.
Cast Ixtal's Impact at Kayn and steer him into a wall to stun him. Kayn's Shadow Step doesn't stop you, because you ignore terrain too.
Use Impale on Kayn when he commits to a fight. It suppresses him, and Umbral Trespass can't save him once he is caught.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, and finish with Upheaval to slow Kayn when he tries to run.
Stay on Kayn with attacks so Quaking reaches full stacks. It adds steady damage against his health.
Use Seismic Bastion when Kayn jumps in. The shield absorbs his burst, and the shockwave slows him.
Fight Kha'Zix near your allies or camps' minions; he does far more damage to a target who is isolated, so stay close to your team.
Use Ixtal's Impact to grab Kha'Zix and carry him into a wall. The impact stuns him, and he can't leap away while he is held.
Cast Shattered Earth before you commit to a fight, then finish with the throw to slow Kha'Zix when he tries to run.
Look for the fight once Kha'Zix has used Leap; he is easier to catch with it on cooldown.
Keep hitting Kha'Zix with attacks to stack Quaking; sustained damage wears down a target who wants to dive and flee.
Save Impale for when Kha'Zix jumps in on your carry; it holds him in place so your team can kill him.
Hit Kindred with Impale when she is far from her allies; she is fragile, and being dragged and suppressed lets you and your team burst her down.
Chase her with Ixtal's Impact when she dashes away; it ignores terrain and you cannot be slowed while charging.
Steer Ixtal's Impact so Kindred hits a wall with you; she takes damage and is stunned.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, then keep attacking her; the final hit slows her so she cannot kite you.
Do not commit into a fight while Lamb's Respite is up; nobody inside can die. Wait for it to end, then finish her.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage with Ixtal's Impact so your empowered attacks are ready when you reach Lee Sin.
Stay on Lee Sin with attacks; Quaking stacks up and deals damage over time if he can't shake you.
Lee Sin's Resonating Strike dash is cut short if you are out of reach, so keep your distance after he lands Sonic Wave.
Use Impale on Lee Sin when he dashes in, since he can dodge it only with a quick escape. Pull him toward your allies.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, not after. The cast time in the middle of a fight leaves you open.
Charge with Ixtal's Impact and drag Lillia into a wall. She is stunned and takes damage, so she cannot run away.
Ixtal's Impact makes you immune to slows, so charge straight through her Swirlseed slow.
Stay on Lillia with attacks to build Quaking. Her fast kiting is weak once you are stuck to her.
Use Impale to pull Lillia out of position before she can use her speed to escape. Impale cannot be dodged once it lands.
Hit Master Yi with Impale when he is not in Alpha Strike. He cannot be targeted during it, and suppression pulls him away from his team.
Slowing Master Yi is wasted once Highlander is active. Use Ixtal's Impact or Impale on him instead, since they are not slows.
Drag Master Yi into a wall with Ixtal's Impact. He is stunned and hurt, and has no escape until it ends.
Keep hitting Master Yi so Quaking stacks. Hurt him often so Meditate costs him mana to heal.
Wukong often uses Warrior Trickster after he dashes in. Wait a moment before using your abilities so they hit the real Wukong.
Cast Shattered Earth before you start a fight, because casting it mid-fight leaves you open.
Keep Impale for when Wukong uses Cyclone. Cyclone has a short windup, so catch him as he starts.
Wukong gets tougher the longer he fights, so burst him quickly. Use Seismic Bastion to shield yourself and slow him when he jumps on you.
Use Ixtal's Impact to catch Naafiri and drag her into a wall; she is stunned and takes damage. Do it when she has no Eviscerate ready to escape.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, so you do not wait out its cast time while Naafiri is already hitting you.
Throw Upheaval when she tries to run; it slows her so you can catch up and keep hitting.
Do not waste Impale while Naafiri is untargetable from The Call of the Pack; wait until she shows up again.
Use Seismic Bastion when she dives in; the shield soaks her burst and the slow helps you stay on her.
Charge at Nidalee with Ixtal's Impact when she is near a wall; hitting terrain while she is dragged stuns her and deals damage.
Cast Shattered Earth before you charge in, so you do not have to wait out its cast time in the middle of the fight.
Use Impale to pull Nidalee out of position when she is caught; she cannot act while suppressed.
Stay on Nidalee with attacks so Quaking builds up; her fragile body takes steady damage from it.
Seismic Bastion gives you a shield and slows her when she pounces onto you.
Save Ixtal's Impact for when Nocturne's Shroud of Darkness is on cooldown; the shield blocks the charge.
Bait Shroud of Darkness with a cheap ability before you cast Impale on Nocturne.
Use Seismic Bastion when Nocturne dashes in; the shield and slow soften his burst.
Stay close to your team when Nocturne casts Paranoia, since he can dash onto any of you.
Break away from Nocturne's tether with Ixtal's Impact before the fear lands.
Hit Nunu with Impale to pull him out of position. Impale can be dodged, so cast it when he cannot easily Flash away.
Stay on Nunu with attacks to stack Quaking. Shattered Earth also slows him, so use it before you fight.
Do not run in a straight line from Biggest Snowball Ever!. Make sharp turns, because the snowball turns slowly.
Leave Nunu's Absolute Zero as soon as it starts. Staying in it slows you more over time, and Flash gets you out for sure.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, not after; the cast time in the middle of a fight leaves you open.
Pantheon's Shield Vault stuns, but Ixtal's Impact makes you immune to slows and he cannot easily run once you grab him.
Drag Pantheon into a wall with Ixtal's Impact to stun him and deal damage.
Hit Pantheon from behind while he braces with Aegis Assault; it blocks damage from the front only.
Use Impale to catch Pantheon when he lands from Grand Starfall.
Charge with Ixtal's Impact toward a wall while you have Qiyana in tow; she is stunned and takes damage when she hits it.
Aim Impale at Qiyana when she dashes in or out of a fight. It holds her in place and drags her toward your team.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, not after, so you are not waiting on its cast time in the middle of the fight.
Throw the boulder with Upheaval when Qiyana tries to leave. It slows her so you can keep hitting her.
Use Seismic Bastion when Qiyana jumps on you. The shield soaks some of her burst and the shockwave slows her.
Do not attack Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up; it hurts you for every attack and he is very tough.
Hit Rammus when his Defensive Ball Curl is off; he is much weaker then.
Watch for Frenzying Taunt before charging with Ixtal's Impact; being taunted stops your charge.
Skarner's Seismic Bastion deals magic damage, so use it on Rammus when his Defensive Ball Curl is off to get more from its damage.
Cast Shattered Earth before you charge in with Ixtal's Impact, so you are not waiting on its cast time in the middle of a fight.
Grab Rek'Sai with Ixtal's Impact and run her into a wall. She takes damage and is stunned.
Save Impale for when Rek'Sai is marked and about to dive on a target. Suppressing her cancels her follow-up.
Stay on Rek'Sai with attacks so Quaking reaches full stacks. Her burrow healing does not stop the damage over time.
Use Seismic Bastion when she pops up next to you. The shield and slow help you win the trade.
Hit Rengar with Impale when he leaps in. It suppresses him, so he can't fight back or escape.
Use Ixtal's Impact to drag Rengar into a wall. The collision stuns him and deals damage.
Cast Seismic Bastion when Rengar jumps on you. The shield absorbs some of his burst and the shockwave leaves him slowed.
Keep Shattered Earth ready before you walk near brush. If Rengar commits to you, start hitting him right away to stack Quaking.
Start Ixtal's Impact only when Sejuani is not close to stunning you. If you are stunned mid-charge, the charge ends and you lose the grab.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage with Ixtal's Impact, so you are not waiting out its cast time while already fighting.
Sejuani is rarely slowed while her Frost Armor is up, so do not count on Shattered Earth or Seismic Bastion to hold her.
Hit Sejuani with several attacks to stack Quaking, and keep sticking to her. She is tanky, so sustained damage is how you beat her.
Slam a wall with Sejuani in tow using Ixtal's Impact for a stun and big damage. Then finish her while she is stunned.
Impale a squishy ally of Sejuani instead of her when you can. Her tankiness makes her a poor target.
Walk carefully around your camps and objectives, because Shaco hides Jack In The Box traps there. Wards or a sweeper help reveal them.
Use Shattered Earth before you engage Shaco. The empowered attacks and the slow on the final hit make it hard for him to escape.
Use Ixtal's Impact to drag Shaco into a wall for a stun, since he is fragile once caught. Beware of his Deceive and traps.
Seismic Bastion gives you a shield and slows Shaco when he jumps in to Backstab you. Cast it as he appears.
Hold Ixtal's Impact for when Shyvana is coming at you or running away. If you grab her and hit a wall, she is stunned and takes damage.
Cast Shattered Earth before you charge in, so you are not waiting on its cast time in the middle of the fight.
Stay on Shyvana with your attacks to build Quaking. Her fights are long, and the stacks add steady damage.
Use Impale on Shyvana before she transforms, or to pull her away from her team. She is hard to catch in Dragon Form.
Seismic Bastion gives you a shield and slows nearby enemies. Use it when Shyvana jumps in.
Use Ixtal's Impact to grab Sylas and run him into a wall; he is stunned and takes damage, and you can finish him while he is stuck.
Cast Shattered Earth before you charge in. Casting it mid-fight leaves you exposed during the cast time.
Aim Impale at Sylas when he is out of position. He can't use Kingslayer's heal while he is held, so it is a safe way to start a kill.
Stay on Sylas with basic attacks so Quaking reaches full stacks. Long fights favor your steady damage.
Use Ixtal's Impact to catch Talon when he is out of position. If you run into a wall with him in tow, he is stunned.
Save Impale for when Talon jumps in on your carry. It pulls him away from the fight and he can't act while it lasts.
Talon is fragile, so stick to him with Shattered Earth. Its final hit slows him and stops him from running off.
Use Seismic Bastion when Talon dives onto you. The shield soaks his burst and the shockwave slows him.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage with Ixtal's Impact, so you are not waiting on its cast time in the fight.
Do not fight Trundle inside his Frozen Domain; he hits faster there and heals more.
Leave Trundle's Pillar of Ice quickly; it slows you, and it can block your charge.
Stick to Trundle with attacks to keep Quaking stacked; his Subjugate drains you, so trade before he reaches level 6.
Charge with Ixtal's Impact toward a wall while carrying Udyr; hitting the wall stuns him and deals damage.
Do not rely on Ixtal's Impact when Udyr has just Awakened Blazing Stampede; he becomes immune to crowd control and can break free.
Cast Shattered Earth before you commit to a fight. Then finish with Upheaval to slow Udyr when he tries to run or close in.
Stick to Udyr and keep hitting him, because stacked Quaking deals extra damage over time and Udyr has little ranged answer.
Use Impale to pull Udyr away from his Iron Mantle shield and your team can kill him, since he cannot act while suppressed.
Cast Shattered Earth before you start a fight, not during it, so you are not stuck in the cast while Vi hits you.
Do not run at Vi with Ixtal's Impact when she is ready to punch; if she knocks you back, the charge ends.
Steer Ixtal's Impact so Vi is carried into a wall; she is stunned and takes damage.
Use Seismic Bastion when Vi dives in; the shield and slow soften her trade.
Keep hitting Vi to stack Quaking; three stacks deal extra damage over time.
Charge with Ixtal's Impact when Viego steps near a wall; slamming him into it stuns him and deals damage.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, not after. Winding it up in the middle of a fight leaves you open.
Use Impale to pull Viego away from his team when he tries to finish a fight. It also stops him from reaching a fallen enemy's body.
Stay on Viego with attacks so Quaking reaches full stacks and his health drops steadily.
Skarner can't be slowed during Ixtal's Impact, so charge in even when Viego tries to slow you.
Save Ixtal's Impact to catch Volibear against a wall; it stuns him, and he can't use Thundering Smash while he is dragged.
Stun from Thundering Smash is coming when Volibear runs at you. Fight back with Shattered Earth ready so you can slow him and keep trading.
Use Seismic Bastion when Volibear jumps on you; the shield and slow soften his trade.
Keep attacking Volibear to stack Quaking; long fights favor your steady damage over his burst.
Aim Impale at Volibear when he is out of position. Dodge his Stormbringer leap, since it slows you.
Use Ixtal's Impact to drag Warwick into a wall; the stun gives you time to hit him.
Warwick heals when he is low, so stay on him with Shattered Earth and finish him with Impale instead of letting him escape.
Do not fight Warwick when you are low on health; Blood Hunt makes him fast and hit quickly against you.
Warwick's Infinite Duress will suppress you; keep your shield from Seismic Bastion for his dive.
Fight Xin Zhao with Shattered Earth ready; its final hit slows him, so he can't easily slip away.
Keep hitting Xin Zhao so Threads of Vibration builds up. Stay on him and the stacks do heavy damage over time.
Use Seismic Bastion when Xin Zhao charges in; the shield absorbs damage and the earthquake slows him.
Do not start Ixtal's Impact near Xin Zhao's Three Talon Strike; its knock up ends your charge.
Use Ixtal's Impact to catch Zac and carry him into a wall. The wall slam stuns him and deals damage.
Zac heals from his goo chunks. Walk over them to destroy them, especially after he trades with you.
When Zac revives as bloblets with Cell Division, hunt every bloblet. If they all die, he dies.
Use Impale on Zac when he is split up from his team. It drags him to your allies, and it also hits other champions.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, then stick to Zac with attacks. Quaking builds up and hurts a tanky target.
Use Ixtal's Impact to catch Zed when he steps up, then drag him into a wall to stun him. He has no easy way out once he is grabbed.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, so Zed gets slowed and takes the big hit as soon as you reach him.
Save Impale for when Zed is on you, and use it to pull him away from your carry. While it lasts he cannot cast Death Mark or his other abilities.
Stay on Zed with attacks. Stacks of Quaking build up, and a full stack deals damage based on his max Health, which works well against a fragile assassin.
Use Seismic Bastion when Zed jumps in. The shield and slow blunt his burst and make it harder for him to stay on you.
Charge in with Ixtal's Impact when Zyra is caught out, then drag her into a wall for a stun and damage. She has little to stop you once you have her.
Cast Shattered Earth before you engage, so you are not waiting out its cast time while Zyra and her plants hit you.
Use Impale to pull Zyra out of position when she is alone with her plants. Skarner is sturdy, so stay on her and keep attacking.
Avoid walking over her seeds while she is near. Zyra can grow them into plants that hit and slow you.
Use Seismic Bastion for the shield when you step into her range, and again when plants gather around you.
